results.name: travel-times.js: 270 exact running times, 125 official distances, 101 transfer pairs
time model is seconds = 23.9 + 63.27 x km (fitted on the exact segments)
every exact / distance edge connects two real stations that are adjacent on that line in the app graph
every transfer pair joins two lines of the SAME station (no missing / wrong transfers)
no duplicated stations / duplicated (line, station code) in data.js
transfer stations unchanged: 120 multi-line stations
all numeric values are positive and finite
raw Seoul Metro CSV re-read independently: 262 consecutive rows compared, every running time and km equal to the generated value
raw transfer CSV re-read independently: 137 rows compared, distance and walking time equal
transfer walking time = distance / 1.2 m/s in the source (rounded to the second)
raw 국가철도공단 distance files re-read independently: 125 segments compared, all equal
bracketed station names now mapped (11/11 of the examples have official distances attached)
only 당고개 and 능길 stay unmapped (they do not exist in data.js; no placeholder stations were invented)
TRAVEL_TIME_DATA_REPORT.md contains the before/after coverage and the Issue #11 audit
official segment: Line 2 강남→교대 uses the exact CSV seconds (tier "official", no model)
distance-only segment: Line 9 uses the official NRA km and the model (tier "derived")
no-data segment: GTX-A uses straight-line km x kappa and the same model (tier "estimated")
whole graph: exact + derived + estimated segments = all adjacent pairs, exact first
"Include express lines" speeds up derived airport-type segments but never touches exact official times
route level: "Include express lines" makes the airport route faster (70 km/h class) …
… and never changes a route made only of official times (Line 2), nor slows a line below the data-calibrated model
official transfer: 서울역 Line 1 → Line 4 = 2:13 (133 s) over 159 m walking, source "official", plus the configured connecting-train wait (120 s)
no official transfer time → configurable default class (Easy 2 / Medium 4 / Long 7 min)
transfer defaults and per-interchange overrides are configurable
60 random origin/destination pairs: no duplicate routes, FASTEST really fastest, FEWEST TRANSFERS really fewest, unique ranks
every route's displayed leg minutes add up exactly to its displayed total
alternates are produced for many pairs; labels are FASTEST / FEWEST TRANSFERS / ALTERNATE
route search stays fast (worst case of the sample)
FASTEST time equals an independent shortest-path search (40 pairs)
1-8 (Line 4+2): 사당 → 동대문역사문화공원 gets a time (22 min, official)
Line 9: 김포공항 → 여의도 gets a time (24 min, derived)
Airport Railroad: 서울역 → 인천공항1터미널 gets a time (59 min, derived)
Suin-Bundang: 수원 → 왕십리 gets a time (68 min, partial)
Shinbundang: 강남 → 판교 gets a time (18 min, derived)
Line 2: 홍대입구 → 잠실 gets a time (35 min, official)
4→7: 동작 → 남성 gets a time (8 min, official)
GTX-A: 서울역 → 수서 gets a time (12 min, estimated)
Sillim: 신림 → 샛강 gets a time (10 min, estimated)
Line 9 times are flagged "derived from official distance" (never "official running time")
Line 2 route is 100% official running times and says so
route cards: 3 options with type, time, transfers, stations, distance
